title: mentha longifolia var. rocheliana
intro: Mentha longifolia var. rocheliana, commonly known as Horehound, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine, particularly for its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which provide relief from respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis, as well as skin conditions like eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of Horehound include essential oils like marrubium, menthol, and limonene, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including bronchodilation, antimicrobial activity, and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its ability to soothe digestive issues and calm the nervous system, making it a popular natural remedy for various health conditions.
